finding.mechanism: canonicalEvidenceMaterial normalizes NFKC/lowercase and then removes all Unicode punctuation, symbols and whitespace via /[\p{P}\p{S}\s]+/gu. This correctly blocks many superficial formatting mutations, but also removes meaning-bearing operators.

minimalCounterexamples.whyDistinct: equality and inequality are not formatting variants

finding.risk: Two provenance-identical but substantively different evidence payloads can receive the same replay identity. The second payload may then be rejected as replayed evidence even though it changes the evidentiary relation. This is false deduplication, not merely conservative formatting normalization.
finding.affectedCapability: canonicalized replay identity across superficial formatting mutations

mustPreserve: purely typographic punctuation normalization where meaning is not changed
requiredFixBoundary.testRequirement: Add a dedicated adversarial operator-preservation test and rerun full NOSTROMO integration before any VAJRA version/status promotion.
